title: Ribbon
description: A line of type set on a turning ring that twists into a Möbius band, so the words read upright at the front, roll edge-on at the sides and come back upside down. Drag sideways to spin it, drag up or down to cut and re-join it with more half twists, and type your own line.
intent: Type as a physical strip: one sentence printed on a band you can spin and twist, re-derived from the twist-then-wrap vertex maths, with every move eased and interruptible.

sources.name: basement.studio laboratory, #52 Twisted 3D text
sources.what: The idea of type twisted along its length and wrapped into a ring; the twist-then-circle maths was re-derived (no licence on the repo), set on a canvas-text strip instead of extruded geometry.

sources.name: Lenis by darkroom.engineering
sources.what: Frame-rate independent damp (MIT) for the twist follower and spin glide.
